summary: The Eagles beat the Dolphins 31-17 on Sunday Night Football on Oct. 22, 2023, at Lincoln Financial Field while wearing Kelly Green. Miami rallied from 17-3 down to tie it with a pick-six, but Philadelphia answered with touchdown drives and shut out Miami's offense in the second half. A.J. Brown had 137 yards and a touchdown, and the win moved the Eagles to 6-1 and dropped Miami to 5-2.
one_line: Philadelphia beat Miami 31-17 on Sunday Night Football in Kelly Green, improving to 6-1 behind A.J. Brown's 137 yards and a late clock-eating drive.
key_facts: The Eagles beat the Dolphins 31-17 on 'Sunday Night Football' on Oct. 22, 2023, at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia.
Quarter scores: Dolphins 3-7-7-0, Eagles 3-14-7-7; Miami's offense did not score in the second half.
Philadelphia improved to 6-1; Miami fell to 5-2 and missed a chance to open a two-game AFC East lead over the Bills, who lost to the Patriots earlier that day.
A.J. Brown had 137 yards and a touchdown, his fifth consecutive game with at least 125 yards.
Jerome Baker returned a deflected Jalen Hurts pass for a pick-six, tying the game 17-17 in the third quarter after Kader Kohou deflected it.
Hurts scored on a Brotherly Shove (tush-push) from the one, putting the Eagles up 17-3 in the second quarter.
Dallas Goedert scored a touchdown on National Tight Ends Day, giving Philadelphia a 10-3 lead.
Tyreek Hill caught a touchdown from Tua Tagovailoa before halftime and had 879 yards on the season at that point.
Jaylen Waddle left with a back injury before halftime but returned in the second half.
Darius Slay intercepted Tagovailoa's pass to Raheem Mostert in the fourth quarter.
Kenneth Gainwell's touchdown made it 31-17 with just under five minutes left, capping a drive of nearly seven minutes.
Julio Jones caught his first pass as an Eagle, a three-yard gain.
The Eagles had not beaten the Dolphins since 2011, when Miami's loss led to coach Tony Sparano's firing.
